title: Weatherdeck card, version 1.x
description: One small status card from one tool. Read-only data: the board never runs or imports the tool. Unknown fields are ignored. Also checked in code, not expressible here: updated_at must be a real calendar time and no more than 5 minutes in the future, and the major version of schema_version must be 1. See docs/ADDINS.md.

tool.description: Stable id of the tool; one card per tool.

headline.description: One line: what a person needs to know.

link.description: Shown as text; the board never fetches it.

mode.description: Optional operating mode, for example advice-only or live-repair.

stale_after_s.description: Seconds after updated_at when the board marks this card stale. Default: cards.stale_after_s in the config.
